text: Would you write the word "pickle" in a library book, just because a stranger asked you to?
In a study by psychologist Vanessa Bohns, about half the people who were asked actually did it.
Because saying no felt too awkward.
Saying no feels like it will damage the relationship.
So you say yes, again and again.
In 2023, researchers Julian Givi and Colleen Kirk studied what happens when you turn down an invitation.
People expected the other person to be hurt, angry, and less likely to invite them again.
It costs you far less than you think.
